stories.title: Ukraine says Starshield service restored after SpaceX speed limits
stories.summary: A Ukrainian Defence Ministry source said Starshield connectivity for units on the move was restored on Oct. 15, a day after SpaceX imposed unannounced speed limits that disrupted drone missions. Kyiv says it is still seeking an explanation for the throttling.

stories.title: Oil slides about 2% as US weighs easing Russia shadow-fleet sanctions
stories.summary: Brent fell roughly 2% toward $104 a barrel on news Washington may ease restrictions on Russia's shadow-fleet tankers, easing supply fears. Ship attacks near the Strait of Hormuz and Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries capped the decline.

stories.title: North Korea test-fires two submarine-launched cruise missiles
stories.summary: KCNA said the North test-fired two types of submarine-launched strategic cruise missiles in the sea off its east coast on Wednesday, calling it a check of underwater war-deterrent reliability. It follows a ballistic missile launch from the Pyongyang area earlier in the week.

stories.title: Musk says Trump ultimately responsible for Starshield curbs
stories.summary: Elon Musk said limits on Ukraine's military-grade Starshield network are decided by the US military and 'ultimately POTUS', after Kyiv accused SpaceX of throttling the service without warning. The row deepens the rift between Kyiv and Washington over intelligence support.

stories.title: Blog: an ISO download turned into a two-zero-day kernel exploit
stories.summary: Engineer's write-up describes reversing an EAP770 access point's firmware to install an ISO, and ending up with a kernel exploit worth two zero-days. It topped Hacker News discussion of how consumer network gear ships exploitable firmware.

stories.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon frontier model globally
stories.summary: Google pushed Gemini 4 Argon, a frontier model tuned for long-horizon agentic workflows, to global availability. It lands in the same 24 hours as Meta's Muse Wonder release, keeping the frontier-model race at full speed.

stories.title: Character.AI files for Chapter 11; Disney leads bid for assets
stories.summary: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection and is selling assets, with Disney serving as lead bidder at $20 million, per filings listing $50-100 million in liabilities. It marks a stark end for one of the first breakout AI chatbot companies.

stories.title: Liquid AI ships LFM2.5-24B-A2B for fast on-device agents
stories.summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a sparse model built for low-latency agent workloads on local hardware. The launch pushes the small-model trend that has been driving open-weight releases this month.

stories.title: Monken's Ravens reunion takes a backseat to Browns' latest test
stories.summary: Todd Monken, Baltimore's former offensive coordinator, faces the first-place Ravens on Sunday as his 3-2 Browns try to retake the AFC North lead. Cleveland's defensive front remains banged up heading into the Week 6 game at Huntington Bank Field.

stories.title: Browns list 16 players on first Week 6 injury report
stories.summary: Cleveland put 16 players on Wednesday's injury report, with Quinshon Judkins, Carson Schwesinger, Mason Graham, Mike Hall Jr. and Tytus Howard among those not practicing. Monken's staff has a short rehabilitation window before hosting the Ravens.

stories.title: Judkins misses Wednesday practice as ankle keeps him day-to-day
stories.summary: Browns running back Quinshon Judkins (ankle) sat out Wednesday's session, though he was seen without his walking boot, leaving him day-to-day for Sunday. Jaleel McLaughlin and newly signed Audric Estime are Cleveland's healthy backs.

stories.title: Indiana lists no players out, Khobie Martin doubtful for Buckeyes visit
stories.summary: Indiana's first Big Ten availability report for Saturday's top-five visit from Ohio State lists no players out, with RB Khobie Martin doubtful and TE Andrew Barker questionable. The Hoosiers are 6-0 and host the No. 4 Buckeyes at noon ET on FOX.

stories.title: Ohio State down two key players against Indiana
stories.summary: Ohio State's initial availability report ruled out offensive lineman Austin Siereveld and running back Ja'Kobi Jackson for Saturday's game at Indiana. Receivers Brandon Inniss and Devin McCuin are expected back for the Big Ten title-game rematch.

stories.title: Ohio State rules two starters out, three questionable for Indiana
stories.summary: Ohio State's first availability report of the week lists starters Ja'Kobi Jackson and Austin Siereveld out, with Brock Boyd, Isaiah West and Khary Wilder questionable for the No. 4 vs No. 5 matchup. Friday's update will settle the picture.

stories.title: Pirelli confirms tyre compounds for the Americas triple header
stories.summary: Pirelli picked C2/C3/C4 as hard/medium/soft for the United States Grand Prix in Austin (Oct 23-25), and the softest C3/C4/C5 trio for both Mexico City and Sao Paulo. Teams now have allocations for the season's closing American swing.

stories.title: Japanese-inspired cafe opens in Bethel Center Mall
stories.summary: A Japanese-inspired cafe is now open inside Bethel Center Mall on Columbus' northwest side, the latest food addition to the redeveloped shopping center. It joins a run of new food and retail openings in central Ohio this fall.

stories.title: Gary Siders Sr. case dismissed after children rescued in Ohio
stories.summary: WCMH reports the case against Gary Siders Sr., which followed the removal of children from an Ohio home, has been dismissed. Two adults had earlier faced charges over conditions at the property.

stories.title: Teen pleads guilty in drunk-driving crash that killed Ohio officer
stories.summary: A teenager pleaded guilty in the drunk-driving crash that killed an Ohio police officer, WCMH reports. The plea closes one stage of a case that has drawn attention to impaired-driving enforcement in central Ohio.

stories.title: The Lion's dog-friendly outdoor Bexley Yard opens Saturday
stories.summary: The owners of Bexley cocktail bar The Lion are opening Bexley Yard, an alcohol- and dog-friendly outdoor space at Cassingham Road and Main Street, with a grand opening Saturday. The lot adds picnic seating, food trucks and acoustic music under Bexley's DORA rules.
